[EN] , a word. There's a rumor going around that Thulsa has captured General Kanmur's soul.

General...Kanmur. The hero of Kaiator. I believe you were there when Killian...returned his body.

I don't care if it's really him or not. Find this abomination and tear it apart!
[ES] , una palabra. Corre el rumor de que Thulsa ha capturado el alma del General Kanmur.

El General... Kanmur. El héroe de Kaiator. Creo que estabas ahí cuando Killian... devolvió su cuerpo.

¡No me importa si realmente es él o no! ¡Encuentra esta abominación y destrútela!

[EN] Well, if it was Kanmur, his soul is free now, as it should be. If it wasn't him, it's good it never saw daylight.
[ES] Bueno, si era Kanmur, su alma ya es libre, como debería ser. Si no era él, qué bueno que nunca vio la luz del sol.
